{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Desserts|Desserts]]

'''Bête Noire''' is a rich flourless chocolate cake. 

Similar recipes include [[Cookbook:Chocolate Orbit Cake|Chocolate Orbit Cake]] and [[Cookbook:Flourless Chocolate Cake|Flourless Chocolate Cake]]. 

==Ingredients==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[cookbook:water|water]]
*1 ⅓ cup white granulated [[cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (120 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[cookbook:Bittersweet chocolate|bittersweet chocolate]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*8 oz (230 g) [[cookbook:Unsweetened chocolate|unsweetened chocolate]], finely chopped
*½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (225 g) [[cookbook:butter|butter]]
*5 beaten [[cookbook:egg|egg]]s

==Procedure==
# Heat the water and sugar together until fully dissolved.
# Melt butter in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over a low heat.
# Add the chopped chocolate to the melted butter, and [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] until smooth.
# Whisk in the sugar syrup and allow to cool slightly.
# Add the eggs and whisk until well blended.
# Pour the mixture into a greased and [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined 9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (23 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]])[[Cookbook:Springform Pan| springform pan]].  
# Wrap the bottom and sides of the springform in aluminum foil so that no water can seep to the cake while it is cooking in the water bath.
# Cook in a [[Cookbook:Bain-marie|bain-marie]] at 350°F (180°C) in an [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for 25–30 minutes.
